item.title: Week 11: Saints at Bears
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: CHI -11.5 · O/U 49.5 | Model CHI 85% vs. market 83% | The game turns on whether New Orleans can manufacture chunk plays, because its offense ranks 31st in explosive rate and must beat a Bears defense that allows 8.9%. Chris Olave draws 26% of New Orleans' targets and faces a Chicago pass defense ranked 11th, while Caleb Williams, a top-four quarterback, outranks Tyler Shough by a wide margin. Our model lands at 85% for Chicago, close to the market's 83%, with the rushing matchup doing most of the work.
